# FOB Security Squad
[bold]Foxtrot[/bold] (GOVFOR) and [bold]Victor[/bold] (OPFOR) are small security squads whose job is to build and secure the FOB.
## Joining - Turn on [bold]FOB SECURITY SQUAD[/bold] in the character menu. - If you join as a [bold]Squad Leader, RTO, Combat Technician or Rifleman[/bold] and the squad has room for that role, you are put in it. If it's full, you join a regular squad as normal. - The squad has its own slots on top of the regular ones: 1 Squad Leader, 1 RTO, 2 Combat Technicians and 1 Rifleman. - If those reserved slots are the only ones left for your role, joining asks whether you want to join the security squad.
## What's Different - Its Squad Leader and RTO have the same construction and engineering skills as Combat Technicians. - Its Combat Technicians get 15 extra vendor points for building materials. - It has its own radio channel and callsign, and shows up on overwatch like any other squad. GOVFOR's Foxtrot channel is on [bold]:f[/bold] and OPFOR's Victor channel on [bold]:v[/bold].
